cs.t: I ordered one with blue switches but they came brown by mistake. Very cheap keyboard, from the brand RedDragon. It was my first, and I really like the feel. I was actually glad for the mixup, because the brown is pretty noise already. I'm afraid I'll wakeup my wife when I type during the night, or even the neighbors! Blue switches would be a nightmare.
cs.th: Ask HN: How is your experience with a mechanical keyboard?
